Compared sparrow’s small beak with eagle’s large, curved, sharp beak.

end.parentNote: Asha practised close observation by linking bird features to their functions and asking Atharv to give examples. Atharv described sparrow and eagle beaks, eagle’s claws, duck’s webbed feet, and toes used for perching. Leaf-shape observation was started with grass as an example, but the teach-back was not completed. At home, look at one bird, plant, or leaf together and ask Atharv to name one visible feature and what it helps the organism do.
